name: flame
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one small Ultrared achievement counter icon for a fantasy zombie board game UI.
Subject: A single compact crimson flame with three broad rising tongues, deep blood-red outer flame and bright scarlet inner core. Strong flame silhouette, no torch or holder.
Style: Zombicide Black Plague / Green Horde fantasy board-game illustration: gritty hand-painted ink-and-paint, strong dark contours, warm parchment-like painted highlights on the object only, rough battle-worn texture, expressive graphic shape. Object stands alone, no ornamental metal frame.
Composition: exactly ONE centered isolated icon on a square transparent canvas, whole silhouette visible with generous 8 percent margin. Designed to downsample to 128x128 and repeat three times in a horizontal row. Broad simple forms, details subordinate to silhouette. No crown.
Constraints: real alpha transparency; no background, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no text, no numerals, no labels, no extra icons, no sheet, no huge splatters, no floating particles, no glow haze. Crimson is the dominant color.
